name: com.talobin.cardentry.ui.CardEntryActivity
description: Talobin Card-Entry opens this form when the app requests card details. It validates the entered card and returns it to the app; expiry, security-code, and postal-code fields plus an optional scan button can be enabled as requested.
disableEffect: Card-payment or card-add flows that use this screen will no longer be able to collect card details.
